Thareeqathul  Aroosiyyathil  Qaadhiriyyah
3
Association of Sri Lanka (Incorporation)
may be owned, possessed, dedicated, associated or
affiliated  to  the  Corporation  including  the
appointment, removal and exercise of control over
trustees  appointed  over  the  said  Mosques,
Thakkiyas,  Madrasas,  Charitable  Trusts,  Muslim
Shrines and Places of Religious resort;
to  institute  legal  proceedings  to  recover  any
property  or  sue  in  action  vested,  belonging,
dedicated or associated with the Spiritual Head of
the  Association;
to institute legal proceedings to advance any of the
objects of the Association;
to  conduct  religious  and  spiritual  rites  of  the
Association;
to promote the sunnath wal jamaath way of Islamic
life  which  is  the  mazhab  oriented  Thareeqathul
Aroosiyyathil Qaadhiriyyah sufistic instruction of
the  Founder  Shaikh  among  the  adherents  of  the
Islamic faith;
to disseminate the mazhab oriented doctrines and
teachings of Islam, Islamic culture and Sufism and
the  promotion  of  activities  for  the  benefit  of  the
community;
to  conduct  research  on  the  work  and  life  of  the
Founder  Shaikh;
to  construct  and  manage  Mosques,  Thakkiyas,
Madrasas, Charitable Trusts, Muslim Shrines and
Places of Religious resort and other institutions;
to  collect  funds  and  accept  endowments  and
materials for the building, repair or maintenance of
